topic: 非谓语动词全能突破（Non-finite Verbs: Infinitive, Gerund & Participles）
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：非谓语动词就像是动词变身成的“斜杠青年”。在英语中，一个句子通常只能有一个主句谓语动词。如果还想表达其他动作，这些动词就必须“变身”为非谓语动词——不定式(to do)、动名词(doing)或分词(doing/done)，分别充当主语、宾语、定语或状语。
2. 【语法公式与口诀】
 - 不定式 (to do)：表“目的、将来、未发生”；
 - 动名词 (doing)：表“习惯、常态、抽象名词化”；
 - 现在分词 (doing)：表“主动、正在进行”；
 - 过去分词 (done)：表“被动、已经完成”。
 - 考场口诀：“一句一谓语，多动非谓补！主用ing，被用ed，目的未做to do立！”
3. 【中小学生易错点】
 - 错点1：双谓语冲突。错误：I like play games. (应为 like playing / to play)
 - 错点2：介词后面误用动词原形。如 look forward to 里的 to 是介词，后面必须加 doing！
 - 错点3：分词作状语时逻辑主语不一致（悬垂分词）。错误：Walking in the park, the bell rang. (树和钟不会走路，逻辑主语必须与句子主语一致)。
4. 【经典例句】
 ① I decided to study hard for the coming exam. (我决定为即将到来的考试努力学习。—— to do表目的/将来)
 ② She enjoys reading storybooks after school. (她喜欢放学后读故事书。—— enjoy后固定接doing)
 ③ Seeing the big dog, the little boy felt scared. (看到大狗，小男孩感到害怕。—— doing作状语，boy与see是主动关系)

questions.question: My younger brother enjoys _____ English storybooks before going to sleep.
questions.explanation: 考查动名词作宾语。enjoy 后面必须接动词的 -ing 形式（enjoy doing sth.），表示“喜欢做某事”。故选 B。

questions.question: It is very important for students _____ healthy food every day.
questions.explanation: 考查动词不定式作真正主语。句型结构为“It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.”，其中的 It 是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式 to eat。故选 C。

questions.question: Don't forget _____ off the lights when you leave the classroom.
questions.explanation: 考查 forget 的用法。forget to do sth. 表示“忘记要做某事（事情尚未做）”；forget doing sth. 表示“忘记做过某事（事情已做）”。根据句意“离开教室时别忘了关灯”，动作尚未发生，应用 to turn。故选 B。

questions.question: The English teacher made all the students _____ (clean) the classroom together.
questions.explanation: 考查使役动词 make 的用法。make sb. do sth. 表示“让/使某人做某事”，后接不带 to 的动词不定式（即动词原形 clean）。

questions.question: Lucy stopped _____ the flowers because it suddenly began to rain.
questions.explanation: 考查 stop 的用法。stop doing sth. 表示“停止正在做的事情”；stop to do sth. 表示“停下来去干另一件事”。因为下雨了，所以是停止“浇花”这一动作，用 watering。故选 A。

questions.question: Tom would like playing soccer with his classmates this Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 考查 would like 的固定搭配。would like 后接动词不定式（would like to do sth.），表示“想要做某事”。应将 playing 改为 to play。

questions.question: My parents agreed _____ me a new bike if I pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 考查 agree 的用法。agree to do sth. 是固定搭配，意为“同意做某事”。故选 C。

questions.question: Thank you so much for _____ (help) me with my English homework.
questions.explanation: 考查介词后接动名词。for 是介词，介词后面后接动词时须使用动名词形式 (doing)，因此填写 helping。

questions.question:
Rewrite using an infinitive (不定式): Tim went to the library. He wanted to borrow some science books.
-> Tim went to the library _____ borrow some science books.
questions.explanation: 考查动词不定式表目的。用 to borrow 做目的状语，连接两句话。

questions.question: We saw a colorful bird _____ in the tree when we walked in the park.
questions.explanation: 考查感官动词 see 的用法。see sb./sth. doing sth. 表示“看见某人/某物正在做某事（强调动作正在进行）”。故选 A。

questions.question: All the children are looking forward to visit the science museum.
questions.explanation: 考查高频避坑点：look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须接名词或动名词（doing）。因此应将 visit 改为 visiting。

questions.question: This box is too heavy for the little girl _____.
questions.explanation: 考查 too... to... 结构。句型“too + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.”意为“太……以至于某人不能做某事”。故选 B。

questions.question: Please remember _____ (lock) the door when you go out.
questions.explanation: 考查 remember to do sth. 表示“记住要做某事（尚未发生）”。出门前提醒“记得关门”，需填 to lock。

questions.question:
Combine into one sentence using a gerund (动名词): Drawing pictures is fun. Lily likes it.
-> Lily likes _____ (draw) pictures.
questions.explanation: 考查动名词做宾语。like doing sth. 表示“喜欢做某事”，将 draw 变为 drawing。

questions.question: What about _____ to the seaside by bike this Sunday?
questions.explanation: 考查提建议句式。What about / How about 其中的 about 为介词，后面跟随动词的 -ing 形式。故选 B。

questions.question: _____ the bad news that her dog was lost, the girl could not help crying.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词作时间状语。句子主语 the girl 与 hear 是主动关系，且动作几乎同时发生，使用现在分词 Hearing 表示“一听到……”。故选 B。

questions.question: The ceramic vase _____ (break) by the playful cat yesterday was an expensive antique.
questions.explanation: 考查过去分词作后置定语。vase（花瓶）与 break（打碎）是被动关系，且动作已完成，故用过去分词 broken。

questions.question: The renowned scientist stepped onto the stage, _____ by a group of passionate students.
questions.explanation: 考查分词作伴随状语。主语 The scientist 与 follow 之间是被动关系（科学家被学生跟随），故用过去分词 followed。故选 B。

questions.question: Walking down the street, the heavy rain started to fall down.
questions.answer: Walking down the street -> As I was walking down the street (or change main clause to: I was caught in the heavy rain)
questions.explanation: 考查压轴避坑点“悬垂分词（Dangling Participle）”。Walking 的逻辑主语不能是 heavy rain（雨不能在街上走）。必须修改为状语从句或调整主句主语使其逻辑一致。

questions.question: He deeply regrets _____ hard when he was studying at secondary school.
questions.explanation: 考查 regret 的用法及非谓语动词的否定形式。regret doing sth. 表示“后悔做过某事”；非谓语动词的否定要在非谓语前加 not，即 not doing。故选 B。

questions.question:
Transform the adverbial clause into a participle phrase:
Because he felt exhausted, Mark went to sleep immediately.
-> _____ (feel) exhausted, Mark went to sleep immediately.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词短语作原因状语。主语 Mark 与 feel 是主动关系，将原因状语从句改写为分词短语 Feeling exhausted。

questions.question: With all the tasks _____ (finish), the project team decided to celebrate their success.
questions.explanation: 考查 with 的复合结构（with + 宾语 + 宾补）。tasks 与 finish 之间是被动且已完成关系，故用过去分词 finished 充当宾语补足语。

questions.question: The suspect was noticed _____ out of the bank with a black bag in his hand.
questions.explanation: 考查感官动词被动语态中的补足语。notice sb. doing 被动语态为 sb. be noticed doing（被注意到正在做某事），强调动作正在进行。故选 C。

questions.question: Have you ever considered _____ abroad to pursue a master's degree?
questions.explanation: 考查 consider 的用法。consider 表示“考虑”时，后面必须跟动名词作宾语（consider doing sth.）。故选 A。

questions.question: The annual report to complete next Friday requires careful reviewing.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式的被动语态作定语。report（报告）与 complete（完成）是被动关系，且表将来（next Friday），因此需用不定式的被动语态 to be completed。

questions.question:
Rewrite using 'so as to':
She woke up early so that she could catch the first bus.
-> She woke up early so as _____ (catch) the first bus.
questions.explanation: 考查目的状语转换。so that + 句子 可转换为 so as to do sth.，表示“为了……”。

questions.question: Strictly _____ (speak), your answer is not entirely accurate according to the rule.
questions.explanation: 考查分词的独立领域固定表达。strictly speaking 为固定短语，意为“严格来说”。

questions.question: There is no point _____ over spilled milk; we need to find a solution now.
questions.explanation: 考查固定句型“There is no point (in) doing sth.”，意为“做某事是没有意义的”。故选 B。

questions.question: The complex issue _____ at yesterday's meeting will be resolved soon.
questions.explanation: 考查分词作定语的时态与语态区分。issue 与 discuss 是被动关系，且发生在昨天（yesterday's meeting，已完成），故用过去分词 discussed。being discussed 表示“正在被讨论”，to be discussed 表示“将要被讨论”。故选 A。

questions.question: Compare with traditional teaching method, online learning offers more flexibility.
questions.explanation: 考查固定分词状语“Compared with/to...”（与……相比）。online learning 与 compare 是被动关系，必须使用过去分词 Compared 开头。
